environment.title: bluem_environment
environment.name: translated: Choose the active mode
environment.description: translated: Enter which mode you want to use: prod, test or acc for the production (live), test or acceptance environment.

senderID.title: bluem_senderID
senderID.name: translated: Bluem Sender ID
senderID.description: translated: The Sender ID issued by Bluem. Starts with an S, followed by a number.

test_accessToken.title: bluem_test_accessToken
test_accessToken.name: translated: Access Token for Testing
test_accessToken.description: translated: The access token used to communicate with Bluem for the test environment.

production_accessToken.title: bluem_production_accessToken
production_accessToken.name: translated: Access Token for Production
production_accessToken.description: translated: The access token used to communicate with Bluem for the production environment.

expectedReturnStatus.title: bluem_expectedReturnStatus
expectedReturnStatus.name: translated: Test mode return status
expectedReturnStatus.description: translated: Which status do you want to receive for a TEST transaction or status request? Possible values: none, success, cancelled, expired, failure, open, pending

suppress_woo.title: bluem_suppress_woo
suppress_woo.name: translated: Use WooCommerce?
suppress_woo.description: translated: Set this to "Do not use WooCommerce" if you want to use this plugin on this site without WooCommerce functionality.

error_reporting_email.title: bluem_error_reporting_email
error_reporting_email.name: translated: Report errors to the developers
error_reporting_email.description: translated: Help us resolve issues quickly and minimize downtime by forwarding non-personal technical notifications.

options.1: translated: Yes, forward errors to the developers
options.0: translated: No error reporting by email

transaction_notification_email.title: bluem_transaction_notification_email
transaction_notification_email.name: translated: Email notification for the website owner for each new transaction?
transaction_notification_email.description: Specify here whether you, as the website owner, want to automatically receive a notification email with transaction details
options: translated: Send a notification for each transaction to owner+<test>@example.invalid
